findings.finding: Shared physical STO identity across SQD and DQD was initially implicit rather than explicit.

findings.finding: The duplicated 215 MHz KTO frequency tick was initially omitted.
findings.resolution: The repeated label and prohibition on deriving a precise lower boundary are now explicitly retained.

findings.finding: SQD and DQD bias-tee distinctions were initially absent.
findings.resolution: Metadata-only family cards now preserve tees, substrate classes, source model/part-code distinction, DQD series capacitance and JPA. Wrong-family and substituted-component tests pass.

findings.finding: Phase-regime classification accepted absent or non-string equal calibration revisions.
findings.resolution: Both expected and observed calibration revisions now require nonempty strings; null, empty, boolean, numeric and container inputs are rejected.

findings.finding: Underflow could yield zero capacitance/sensitivity or an unnormalized math exception.
findings.resolution: Nonpositive derived values and out-of-range arithmetic now raise ContractError; regressions pass.

findings.finding: JPA paired-readout metadata did not initially represent carrier/acquisition plan, region or baseline compatibility.
findings.evidence: DQD_JPA_COMPARISON design requirements and independent schema inspection
findings.resolution: Mandatory shared carrier_plan_revision, acquisition_plan_revision, comparison_region_id and baseline_revision fields were added; each mismatch is rejected.

findings.finding: Freezing a package could overwrite an external symlink target through the manifest path before rejection.
findings.resolution: Freeze now rejects a linked/nonregular manifest before writing and atomically publishes a regular temporary manifest. External sentinel remains unchanged.

findings.finding: Building a ZIP could overwrite a symlink destination target.
findings.resolution: Archive destination and ancestor symlinks are rejected before opening the output. External sentinel remains unchanged.

findings.finding: Freeze could rewrite an existing manifest before rejecting an extra package file.
findings.resolution: Complete prefreeze inventory is checked before new hashes are published. Rejected trees leave the manifest unchanged.

findings.finding: Directory inventory accepted unlisted empty directories.
findings.resolution: Only directories derived from the exact file allowlist are permitted; an extra empty directory is rejected.

findings.finding: Field and dual-frequency scans needed the SQD-circuit context of Figure 4 rather than fixed-load ancestry.
findings.resolution: Both branches now require SQD baseline and CNT_SQD full-preparation ancestry, with explicit complex-reflection/phase mode and no charge-sensitivity credit. Direct scope tests pass.

findings.finding: An assembly-only fixture needed incoming fabricated ancestry without raw-fabrication credit.
findings.resolution: Assembly now verifies prepared constituent ancestry before die attachment and keeps fabrication_credit false. Direct ordering/credit tests pass.

findings.finding: A generic comparison context could conflate STO and KTO constituent specimen identities.
findings.resolution: Explicit distinct sample/material identities now accompany each appropriate full-preparation receipt and raw comparison record; prepared ancestry carries the same constituents. The top-level identity is a comparison bundle. A self-rehashed constituent-collision mutation is rejected.

dependencies.rule: Exact source partial-order and receipt contracts below; no universal executable instance graph is inferred from membership.

dependencies.graph_rule: Receipt dependencies establish partial order; independent safety and analysis branches can interleave when their own dependencies are satisfied

routes.credit: Fabrication ancestry requires independent fabrication and assembly receipts; no source authorship or live execution credit

closure: A shutdown request is never safety evidence
Unknown electrical, magnetic or cryogenic safety remains contained

Archive successful, failed and held attempts before final closure
Physical cleanup and disposal require external receipts; no implemented routine
